agent.f.foresight.whatIfSub: In the chat and as “Play through” on disks
agent.f.foresight.whatIfIntro: Plays through on a model of the NAS what happens when a disk fails, a volume runs full or another RAID level were chosen. It only computes; nothing on the NAS changes.
agent.f.foresight.whatIfWhere: Found under Storage › disk or volume › “Play through” and in the chat, e.g. “What happens if sdb fails?”
agent.f.foresight.whatIfData: Only values titand knows anyway are used: volumes and disks, cached SMART values, the measured rebuild speed and the last success of every backup. No disk is woken.
agent.f.foresight.set.predictSub: From the SMART history: reallocated and pending sectors, read errors, wear, time in service
agent.f.foresight.set.bottlenecksSub: Memory, volumes, CPU, graphics card, temperatures
agent.f.foresight.set.pricesSub: Searches the web for a replacement of disks at risk, with model and size only
agent.f.foresight.set.pricesNoWeb: The web search is blocked in the agent’s rights; without it there are no prices.
agent.f.foresight.set.monthlySub: Once a month a message over the notifications set up
agent.f.foresight.set.atHint: Waits while disks sleep and makes the run up during the day.
agent.f.foresight.empty: No report yet. The first run comes at night, or check now.
agent.f.foresight.noHistory: Computed without the SMART history, with today’s values only (the volume with the history was asleep).
agent.f.foresight.footer: Computes at night only with values that are there without waking the disks.
agent.f.foresight.footerNoPrices: Replacement with price is switched off (needs the web search).
agent.f.foresight.offers: Replacement from the web search (foreign pages, not checked)
agent.f.foresight.failHead: {disk} will probably fail in the coming months
agent.f.foresight.c.smartFailed: The disk itself reports a failure (SMART)
agent.f.foresight.c.wornOutDays: {percent} % worn, at the end in about {days} days
agent.f.foresight.c.sectorsStable: {to} reallocated sectors, the same for weeks
agent.f.foresight.c.cable: CRC errors rising: check the cable or port, not the disk
agent.f.foresight.c.noSmart: No SMART values, asleep since the start
agent.f.foresight.c.volumeFilling: {percent} % full · at the current growth full in about {days} days
agent.f.foresight.c.cpuBusy: {percent} % on average, {hours} hours of the last day under heavy load
agent.f.foresight.c.gpuFull: Graphics memory full: {used} of {total} · a smaller model or more graphics memory
agent.f.foresight.o.redundantSub: {level} with {n} disks: if {disk} fails, there is still a copy of all data.
agent.f.foresight.o.noRedundancySub: {level} with {n} disks: if {disk} fails, all {bytes} depend on the remaining disks.
agent.f.foresight.o.lostSub: {level}: if {disk} fails, the {bytes} only come back from a backup.
agent.f.foresight.o.possiblyLostSub: RAID 10 with a disk failed already: whether the {bytes} stay depends on which disk fails.
agent.f.foresight.o.alreadyFailedSub: Volume {volume} waits for a replacement disk.
agent.f.foresight.o.spareSub: Nothing is lost, but the spare is gone afterwards.
agent.f.foresight.o.cacheLost: {disk} is the read and write cache of {volume}
agent.f.foresight.o.cacheLostSub: What was not yet written to the disks would be lost.
agent.f.foresight.o.cacheNoLossSub: It gets slower; nothing is lost.
agent.f.foresight.rebuildSub: With a new {size} disk about {time} ({how}: {speed} MB/s)
agent.f.foresight.rebuildBtrfs: Spread {size} of data again, about {time} ({how}: {speed} MB/s)
agent.f.foresight.auto: Starts by itself with the spare.
agent.f.foresight.r.longRebuild: The rebuild takes more than a day
agent.f.foresight.r.unknownSmart: There are no SMART values of {disk}
agent.f.foresight.gap.days: “{share}”{size} has had no backup for {days} days
agent.f.foresight.gap.never: “{share}” has no backup outside the volume
agent.f.foresight.gap.unknown: “{share}”: state of the backup not known right now
agent.f.foresight.snapshots: Snapshots lie on the same disks and do not protect against their failure.
agent.f.foresight.full.head: Volume {volume} is {pct} % full
agent.f.foresight.full.days: At the current growth ({perDay} a day) full in about {days} days; {free} free.
agent.f.foresight.e.agentStops: The AI agent can no longer save anything
agent.f.foresight.lv.head: {to} instead of {from}
agent.f.foresight.lv.toleranceSub: Today the volume survives {a} failed disk(s), with {to} {b}
agent.f.foresight.lv.noFit: The {used} in use do not fit.
agent.f.foresight.lv.newVolume: Only via a new volume and copying; back up first.
agent.f.foresight.a.mirror: Consider a volume with a mirror
agent.f.foresight.a.checkCableSub: CRC errors mostly come from the cable or port.
agent.f.foresight.a.addSpareSub: Then the rebuild starts by itself.
agent.f.foresight.footerWhatIf: Computed only; nothing on the NAS was changed.
